title: ourisia macrophylla subsp. robusta
intro: Ourisia macrophylla subsp. robusta, commonly known as the robust giant forget-me-not, is a plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is used to treat various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Ourisia macrophylla subsp. robusta include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
